title: 深夜走廊 EP01（16:9 电影质感示例）
style: Live-action, cinematic, shot on 35mm anamorphic, shallow depth of field, cool fluorescent corridor light with a warm practical lamp at the nurses' station, fine film grain
synopsis: 女律师林岚深夜在医院走廊截住周医生，逼问母亲病情被隐瞒的真相。

characters.name: 林岚
characters.identity_phrase: a woman in her early thirties with a sharp oval face, short black hair tucked behind her ears, dark brown eyes, a fitted black suit jacket over a white shirt, and a thin silver watch on her left wrist
characters.voice_phrase: a woman in her early thirties with a low, controlled voice and clipped, unhurried pace

characters.name: 周医生
characters.identity_phrase: a man in his fifties with a lean face, grey-streaked short hair, thin gold-rimmed glasses, a white doctor's coat over a pale blue shirt, and a stethoscope around his neck
characters.voice_phrase: a man in his fifties with a tired, gravelly voice and slow, measured delivery

scenes.name: 医院走廊
scenes.description: a long hospital corridor at night: pale green walls, a row of closed ward doors on the left, a dark nurses' station with a single warm desk lamp on the right, polished floor reflecting the overhead fluorescent tubes, an exit sign glowing green at the far end

props.name: 牛皮纸病历袋
props.description: a worn brown kraft-paper medical records envelope with a red hospital stamp in the corner

shots.framing: a wide shot down the full length of the corridor from a low tripod height, the exit sign small at the far end
shots.camera: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed down the corridor toward the two of them
shots.action: {dr_zhou} walks away from the camera down the center of the corridor toward the green exit sign, head lowered, both hands buried in the pockets of his white coat, his rubber soles squeaking faintly on the polished floor; at the nurses' station {lin_lan} steps out from behind the counter into his path, stops one meter in front of him with her arms at her sides and her weight on her back foot, and he halts; both keep their lips closed and their eyes on each other; the corridor behind them stays empty, every ward door closed, the only movement the faint flicker of one fluorescent tube
shots.lighting: cool fluorescent overhead light, the warm desk lamp at the nurses' station the only warm source
shots.sound_cue: his rubber soles squeak twice on the polished floor and stop

shots.framing: a medium close-up over Dr Zhou's right shoulder onto Lin Lan, his shoulder soft in the foreground, her face sharp
shots.camera: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed
shots.action: {lin_lan} tilts her chin up to look at {dr_zhou}, her jaw tight and her dark eyes steady, the warm desk lamp behind her lighting the edge of her short black hair while the cool fluorescent tubes light her face; she speaks in a low controlled voice, each word deliberate, while {dr_zhou} listens with his mouth closed, his shoulders stiffening under the white coat; a strand of hair slips loose over her ear and she leaves it
shots.performance: trigger: he halts in front of her; reception: her jaw tightens and her breathing slows; response: she lifts her chin and holds his gaze; settled: she waits with her hands at her sides

segments.soundscape: The steady hum of fluorescent tubes overhead, Dr Zhou's rubber soles squeaking twice on the polished floor and then stopping, a ward monitor beeping once far down the corridor, the faint click of the nurses' station lamp switch, Lin Lan's calm voice close to the camera
segments.end_state: Lin Lan stands facing the camera at frame left in a medium close-up, Dr Zhou's shoulder at frame right; both still, under cool fluorescent light with the warm lamp behind Lin Lan.
segments.continuity: Opening segment: establish both outfits exactly as in the reference sheets, the corridor layout with the nurses' station on the right, and the two light sources (cool fluorescent overhead, warm desk lamp).
segments.style: Live-action, cinematic, shot on 35mm anamorphic, shallow depth of field, cool fluorescent corridor light with a warm practical lamp at the nurses' station, fine film grain

shots.framing: a medium close-up on Dr Zhou, reverse angle over Lin Lan's shoulder
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot
shots.action: {dr_zhou} holds Lin Lan's gaze for a long beat, then lowers his eyes to the floor, draws a slow breath, and with his right hand pulls {prop_folder} out from inside his white coat, holding the worn envelope flat against his chest with both hands, the red hospital stamp facing the camera; his lips stay closed and his glasses catch a thin line of fluorescent light
shots.performance: trigger: her question; reception: his eyes drop to the floor; response: a slow breath before he reaches into his coat; settled: the envelope pressed flat to his chest
shots.sound_cue: the kraft-paper envelope rustles against the cotton of his coat

shots.framing: a close-up on Dr Zhou's face
shots.camera: The camera pushes in with small amplitude at slow speed
shots.action: {dr_zhou} raises his eyes again to Lin Lan, the fluorescent light flaring briefly across his gold-rimmed glasses, and speaks in a tired gravelly voice with slow measured pauses, his hands still pressing the envelope to his chest, while {lin_lan}, visible at the right edge of the frame, listens with her mouth closed, rooted to the spot, only her chest rising with a slow breath

dialogue.speaker: dr_zhou
dialogue.text: 从你母亲住院的第一天起。

shots.lighting: the fluorescent tube above flares briefly across his glasses

shots.framing: a close-up on Lin Lan's face
shots.camera: The camera holds a static shot
shots.action: {lin_lan} hears the words and her composure cracks: her eyes widen slightly, she presses her lips together and swallows once, her gaze drops to the envelope in his hands and then lifts back to his face, the warm lamp light on the left side of her face and the cool fluorescent light on the right; she stays rooted where she stands, breathing visibly

segments.soundscape: The fluorescent hum continues without change, the dry rustle of the kraft-paper envelope sliding against the cotton of the white coat, a single distant elevator chime, Dr Zhou's low voice with a slight rasp, Lin Lan's sharp intake of breath
segments.end_state: Lin Lan in close-up at frame center, lips parted, eyes glistening; Dr Zhou out of frame holding the envelope against his chest; same corridor lighting.
segments.continuity: Same positions as end of s01: Lin Lan frame left facing camera, Dr Zhou frame right; outfits unchanged; envelope now visible in Dr Zhou's hands.
segments.style: Live-action, cinematic, shot on 35mm anamorphic, shallow depth of field, cool fluorescent corridor light with a warm practical lamp at the nurses' station, fine film grain
